method_outcomes.B25: Exact count-twice identity equates aggregate posterior/free-energy pressure and latent two-copy Gram pressure. Under a convergent common cluster expansion, bulk replica linearity Phi_2=2 Phi_1 outside an interface gives Pi_2 <= (C_2+2 C_1)|I|; approximate rooted bulk mismatch rho gives Pi_2 <= (C_2+2 C_1)|I|+N rho.
method_outcomes.B15: Normalizer-balanced priors are quantitatively stable: pointwise density-ratio distortion exp(+-epsilon) costs at most 2 epsilon in Renyi pressure; a Gram-operator bound gives L2 prior stability. Exact biased-sign stress yields Pi_2=n log(1+m_n^2 tanh(lambda)^2), so n m_n^2=o(D_n) is the source-scale prior-bias threshold.
method_outcomes.B22: High temperature, approximate tensorization, and quasi-local spectral flow do not by themselves imply source-scale pressure. A checkable sufficient local hypothesis is two-replica factor-table decoupling outside a small interface plus KP/rooted convergence; approximate local decoupling must have rooted mismatch rho_n=o(D_n/N_n).

new_mechanisms: Replica-connected pressure Pi_2=log Z_2-2 log Z_1, so replica-linear bulk cluster contributions cancel exactly.

Prior/quadrature robustness via pointwise density ratio and latent Gram operator.
Factor-table replica-decoupling criterion explaining why bulk volume free energy cancels.
